infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ARNAS requires access to your photo library to automatically back up and sync your media with your private family drive.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: ARNAS requires permission to save downloaded media to your library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ARNAS utilizes location to automatically verify trusted home and office Wi-Fi geofences before synchronizing your files.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ARNAS background sentinel sync verifies your trusted geofence location to ensure auto-backup runs only on designated networks.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: ARNAS uses your location to verify trusted home or office geofences for automated Wi-Fi backup.

plugins.photosPermission: Grant ARNAS access to sync your photos to your private family cloud.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow ARNAS to download family photos to your phone.
